body.x: D-MAKERS Co., Ltd. (CEO Jin Woung Jang) will exhibit at CES 2025 in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10. The company will unveil its advanced drone solutions tailored to diverse industries.

D-MAKERS specializes in developing domestic unmanned autonomous platforms with cutting-edge communication and AI technology. Their offerings span drones, multicopters, rovers, smart buoys, and boats, showcasing versatile platforms integrated with cameras and in-house-developed communication modules. The company emphasizes complete in-house processes, including design, engineering, and production, ensuring high-quality and adaptable solutions for civil, industrial, agricultural, and military applications.

D-MAKERS aims to meet a wide range of customer needs through its innovative autonomous platforms while positioning itself as a leader in the global drone market. The company’s proprietary technology underpins its ability to deliver high-value, efficient, and safe solutions across various industries.

At CES 2025, D-MAKERS will showcase drones equipped with the latest AI technology and autonomous flight systems. These drones will address object recognition, infrastructure inspection, smart agriculture, autonomous navigation, and surveillance applications. This aligns with the company’s mission to expand drone usage across industries and create bespoke product lineups for diverse customer needs.

The drones are engineered with optimized structures, factoring in aerodynamic properties, rigidity, and durability. D-MAKERS' proprietary communication module leverages LTE and 5G networks, enabling seamless control in urban environments with obstacles and high-rise buildings. These features make their drones ideal for applications in smart agriculture, infrastructure inspection, disaster response, and more.

body.cap: 'Nova' drone and GIGA-STATION mobile ground control system | Image provided by D-MAKERS

body.x: The company will introduce "Nova," a drone featuring an innovative dual-diamond aerodynamic design that minimizes air resistance. This design enhances modularity, offering flexibility and scalability for various missions, including industrial inspections, environmental monitoring, and emergency response.

The GIGA-STATION (GCS) mobile ground control system will also be showcased. This integrated product supports autonomous and manual mission distribution, multi-drone operation, and AI-based autonomous surveillance capabilities. 5G technology enables seamless operations in any network-connected location, regardless of distance. Its portable design ensures rapid deployment across diverse environments, making it suitable for logistics, disaster management, and security applications.

D-MAKERS is actively negotiating export agreements for agricultural and industrial drones with countries like the United States and Japan. The company is also exploring new partnerships and expanding its presence in emerging markets across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. By tailoring solutions to meet regional requirements and regulatory standards, D-MAKERS seeks to increase its global adoption rate.

In addition to drones, D-MAKERS plans to expand its product lineup to include autonomous ground vehicles, smart buoys, and integrated IoT solutions, offering comprehensive solutions driven by advanced technology. The company aims to accelerate its technological development and market expansion through active participation in international exhibitions and forums.
